mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transport_task (task_code, cargo_id, measurement_session_id, measurement_id, vehicle_id, destination_slot_code, destination_x, destination_y, destination_heading, fork_height, status, assigned_at, started_at, picked_up_at, completed_at, failed_at, created_at) VALUES (#{taskCode}, #{cargoId}, #{measurementSessionId}, #{measurementId}, #{vehicleId}, #{destinationSlotCode}, #{destinationX}, #{destinationY}, #{destinationHeading}, #{forkHeight}, #{status}, #{assignedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{pickedUpAt}, #{completedAt}, #{failedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM transport_task WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ORDER BY vehicle_id, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE transport_task SET vehicle_id=#{vehicleId}, status='ASSIGNED', assigned_at=#{assignedAt} WHERE task_code=#{taskCode} AND status='PENDING' AND vehicle_id IS NULL
UPDATE transport_task SET status=#{status}, started_at=#{startedAt}, picked_up_at=#{pickedUpAt}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, failed_at=#{failedAt}, task_code=task_code WHERE task_code=#{taskCode}
UPDATE transport_task SET status=#{targetStatus}, started_at=#{startedAt}, picked_up_at=#{pickedUpAt}, failed_at=#{failedAt}, task_code=task_code WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{expectedStatus}

UPDATE transport_task SET measurement_id=#{measurementId}, destination_slot_code=#{destinationSlotCode}, destination_x=#{destinationX}, destination_y=#{destinationY}, destination_heading=#{destinationHeading}, fork_height=#{forkHeight}, status='PICKING_UP' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='MEASURING' AND measurement_id IS NULL
UPDATE transport_task SET measurement_session_id=#{sessionId}, status='MEASURING' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='MOVING_TO_PICKUP' AND measurement_session_id IS NULL
